comment: Doodad models that block the player in game but carry no collision mesh in their M2. MaNGOS drops those placements, so the navmesh keeps a clear passage straight through them and the bot walks into the object. For the models listed here only, the extractor falls back to the M2 header box (collision_box at 0xBC when it holds something, otherwise the render bounding box at 0xA0), capped by KnownPhysicalDoodads.MaxBoxSide. Matching is a case-insensitive substring of the M2 path, so one entry covers every spelling and every numbered variant of a family. Keep this list short: a blanket fallback would use render boxes -- flames, banners, foliage -- on more than 1.6 million placements.

entries.comment: Elwynn battle glade trophies: woven straw shield, banner, planted sword, polearm with skull. Tall decorations set against walls; they block the player in game but carry no collision mesh.
